config.scale_rule: at each origin use up to 60 previous same-model same-horizon errors with target <= origin, minimum20, same order statistic and floor1
config.activation_gate: candidate fixed on calibration only; activate per model/h if evaluation coverage distance to 80% and mean interval score do not worsen; at least 30 evaluation origins
config.nonoverlap: every h-th evaluation origin anchored at first evaluation origin
config.origin_cohort: 2026 origins with 60 matured one-step errors and all 22 future valid observed sessions
config.forecast_function: src.models.forecast_path.forecast; observation_dates supplies dates only, no future prices
config.historical_service: LocalRidgeService.predict reused with frozen end-2025 estimator and raw/features truncated at origin
config.role: post-fixed-study adaptive retrospective analysis on the same already-inspected later period; no new holdout
config.serving_transfer: historical scale applied to October bundle only as a disclosed demo policy; no validation of that bundle
config.serving_policy: freeze the latest available causal scale; model-specific transfer to current October bundle remains unvalidated
